notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to any color is at least three.
description:
Activate Myr Welder using Nyx Lotus's ability by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color you have devotion to.
If Voltaic Construct is on the battlefield, activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Myr Welder. Otherwise, activate Myr Welder using Voltaic Construct's ability by paying {2}, untapping Myr Welder.
Repeat.
